name: Greek Organization of Football Prognostics S.A.
summary: Greek Organization of Football Prognostics S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates and manages numerical lottery and sports betting games. It operates through Lotteries, Sports Betting, Instant & Passives, VLTs, Telecommunication & eMoney Services, and Other segments. The company holds rights to conduct, manage, organize, and operate six numerical lottery games comprising TZOKER, LOTTO, PROTO, EXTRA 5, SUPER 3, and KINO; three sports and other betting games, such as PAME STOIXIMA, PAME STOIXIMA Virtual Sports, PROPO, PROPOGOAL, and HORSE RACING STOIXIMA; three lottery games, including LAIKO, ETHNIKO, and STATE; and Instant SCRATCH games. It also holds license for the instalment and operation of 35,000 video lottery terminals. In addition, the company provides transaction services through electronic means; and intangible talk time selling and bill payments services. Further, it organizes and conducts terrestrial, land-based, and online horseracing mutual betting; and provides software services. The company offers its products and services through online and distribution networks, including agents, street vendors, retailers, wholesalers, and 9,468 points of sales in Greece; 428 play stores; and 199 stores in Cyprus. Greek Organisation of Football Prognostics S.A. was founded in 1958 and is based in Athens, Greece.
